BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL of the Town of Chipley,

Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by authority of same that on and after the adoption of this ordinance, the Town Council shall have authority to have certain buildings condemned, when these buildings are found to be in an unsafe, or untenable condition, according to the ordinance.

Definition of Unsafe buildings

- (a) A building shail be considered unsafe when construction of same has deteriorated to the extent of being unsafe for accupancy as a dwelling or place of business.

Definition of Untenable Buildings

A building shali be be considered untenable:

(a} When the building is not sdequately provided with uncontaminated fresh water supply; or

- (b) When it is not equipped with sanitary sewage disposal plants; or

(c} When a building has on facilities whatever for the disposition of sewage.

To Determine unsafe buildings

In order to determine when a building is unsafe in accordance with this ordinance, the opinions of three (3) competent persons shail be obtained and the majority will govern.

Corrective steps required of Property Owner:

When property is condemned under this ordinance, the owner of the property shall be advised of the condemnation thereof, and shall be given a period of sixty days to take corrective steps, which will be set out by the Town Council at the institution of condemnation proceedings.

Failure to Take Corrective Steps:

If, upon the expiration of the sixty days, the property owner has failed to take such corrective steps, the town shall either sell the property at public outcry, or shall possess said property by purchase.

Determination of Value of Property:

To determine the purchese price of the property, should the town choose to purchase, three disinterested parties shall set a fair value to the property condemned and the town shall pay the price thus established.

How Appraisers Chosen: (a) The Town Council shall appoint one party; (b) The property owner shall appoint one party; and

(c} These two, so chosen, shall choose 8 third party.

- 8. Property scquired by Town to be Corrected, or Sole: When the Town shall scquire such condemned property, it shall be corrected by the town, the expense to be borne by the General Fund or the city, or the property shall be sold by the town authorities to private persons.

- 9. Express Condition with Purchase: When, however, a private person shall make such purchase fron the city, or at the public sale, it shall be with an express condition that corrective construction or installation shell be made within sixty days after purchase.

1¢. Unconstitutionality of Part or All of this Ordinance: If at any time, part of this ordinance shali be declared unconstitutional, it will have no effect on the remainder of this ordinance.

- 11. Other ordinances: All ordinances or part of ordinances in conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed.
